name: mujoco
description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
one_liner: A free, highly realistic physics engine that lets you test how a robot or mechanical design moves and reacts to the real world entirely in simulation, before building anything physical.
buyer: A hardware or robotics startup founder who needs to prototype and test a robot design cheaply before spending money on physical prototypes.
business_use_cases: A robotics startup trains and validates a warehouse-picking robot's movement in MuJoCo before committing to expensive physical hardware iterations.
A university spinout offers paid simulation-as-a-service, running clients' robot designs through MuJoCo to catch mechanical flaws early.
A robotics recruiter or bootcamp uses MuJoCo-based projects as a hands-on portfolio piece to place engineers into robotics companies.

money_ideas.idea: Paid simulation consulting: validate a client's robot or mechanism design in MuJoCo before they build hardware
Hosted cloud service running large batches of MuJoCo simulations for robotics teams who don't want to manage infrastructure

steal_this: Offer a fixed-price 'pre-flight simulation check' to a local robotics or hardware startup: model their mechanism in MuJoCo and report where it breaks, before they cut metal.
